changes: Static SPA fallback is 200.html, matching deploy/Caddyfile.

Logout always attempts Auth sign-out after push cleanup, clears session/profile/notices and private notification polling, and removes only this project's persisted credentials even when Auth returns or throws an error.
Queued stale auth callbacks cannot restart private polling after logout; logout errors state that this device is signed out.
Admin violation management pages users and violation records independently in batches of 20; selected borrower UUIDs remain visible and stable across user pages.
Violation rows use joined borrower names and institutional IDs, and pagination reuses existing buttons/tokens with wrapping for narrow screens.
Static fallback CSP is generated by supported SvelteKit kit.csp hash mode; only self and exact framework-generated hashes allow JavaScript.
regressions: Push deletion HTTP 503 still attempts browser unsubscribe and Auth sign-out.
Browser push unsubscribe rejection still attempts Auth sign-out.
Returned and thrown Auth errors clear persisted session/user/verifier keys while preserving unrelated storage.
Logout stops realtime/polling state and removes bearer authorization from subsequent API calls.
A queued signed-in callback cannot resubscribe notifications after logout.
A selected borrower outside the current page remains an option with the same UUID, including an empty page.
A borrower found again on a later page is not duplicated and uses the updated profile record.
Admin accounts are excluded from borrower options.
A fallback without framework CSP metadata fails the read-only build assertion.
Every emitted inline bootstrap script must match an exact allowed hash; arbitrary injected script bytes do not match.
Same-origin application modules remain allowed and must exist in the build output.

admin_pagination.selected_user: Retained profile option and UUID binding; selection snapshot reads the native change event value.
admin_pagination.style_change: Existing .pagination adds flex-wrap: wrap; no new color, typography, radius, or spacing tokens.

limits: Network/auth failures are simulated in unit tests; live Supabase session revocation was not exercised.
Remote cleanup may remain incomplete while offline; local credentials and authenticated state are cleared.
The UI detector was not rerun, as requested.
The 101-user and older-record browser regressions are delegated to the full E2E suite; no browser tests were run by this frontend task.
Native Caddy hydration and browser enforcement are delegated to the E2E agent; the local build assertion verifies policy bytes and resources.

static_csp.generation: Framework static fallback generation prerenders 200.html and emits CSP through its head metadata.
static_csp.script_sources: self and automatically generated sha256 hashes; no unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, or remote script sources
static_csp.test_command: npm run test:csp; also runs automatically after vite build
static_csp.assertion: frontend/scripts/check-csp.mjs reads the generated artifact without modifying it.
static_csp.caddy_header: frame-ancestors none; base-uri self; form-action self; no fetch directives that conflict with HTML hashes
static_csp.documentation_note: Current docs describe SvelteKit 3 config placement; installed 2.70.3 source confirms kit.csp support in svelte.config.js.
